cards.answer: Rammus is a tank who accelerates into enemies and taunts a target into attacking him. His damaging abilities deal magic damage, and armor and magic resistance also increase his attack damage. His defensive stance increases his resistances and damages enemies that attack him.
cards.counterplay: Keep distance from his engage and avoid basic attacks into his defensive stance when possible.

cards.answer: Powerball gradually increases Rammus's movement speed as he rolls. Colliding with an enemy ends the roll, dealing nearby enemies magic damage, knocking them back, briefly stunning them and slowing them.
cards.counterplay: Keep your distance as he accelerates and spread out to limit the impact.

facts.claim: Colliding with an enemy ends the roll, dealing nearby enemies magic damage, knocking them back, briefly stunning them and slowing them.

cards.priority_reason: His main approach tool threatens nearby enemies with crowd control.

cards.answer: Defensive Ball Curl increases Rammus's armor and magic resistance. Enemies that land basic attacks on him take magic damage; attacks and abilities that apply on-hit effects can also trigger this retaliation.
cards.counterplay: Avoid attacking into his defensive stance when possible; redirect attacks or wait for it to end.

cards.priority_reason: Attacking him during this stance exposes attackers to retaliation.

cards.answer: Frenzying Taunt forces a targeted enemy champion or monster to attack Rammus. It also deals magic damage to monsters.
cards.counterplay: Keep distance to reduce his opportunities to taunt you into his defensive stance.

cards.answer: Soaring Slam leaps to a target area with crowd-control immunity during the leap, then deals magic damage and slows nearby enemies. Its range increases with movement speed, and aftershocks refresh the slow. When cast during Powerball, the impact also knocks up enemies near its center and deals Powerball's damage to them.
cards.counterplay: Move away from the landing area and leave the aftershock zone; avoid relying on crowd control during his leap.
